chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from 'Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who killed another man by mistake during the Sacred Months.

He said: "He must pay the blood-money and fast two consecutive months from the Sacred Months." I said: This includes the 'Id and the days of al-Tashriq. So he said: "He fasts it, for it is a duty that has become binding upon him."

key_terms.أَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ: the Sacred Months, a sanctified period with special legal consequences
key_terms.أَيَّامُ التَّشْرِيقِ: the days of Tashriq, referenced here as falling within the period of the required fasting
key_terms.الْعِيدُ: the festival day mentioned here in relation to the fasting ruling
key_terms.حَقٌّ لَزِمَهُ: a binding obligation that has become incumbent upon him
key_terms.صَوْمُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ: fasting two consecutive months as expiation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for accidental killing in the Sacred Months according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the legal ruling for accidental killing during the Sacred Months. It states that the killer must pay the blood-money and fast two consecutive months within the Sacred Months, and that this obligation remains binding even when it includes the 'Id and the days of al-Tashriq.
